meta.name: SURFER TV
meta.description:
Blends soulful storytelling, competition coverage and a deep connection to the culture, music, and environment that unite the global surf community. Whether you paddle out daily or dream of the perfect wave, it brings the ocean 24/7.

Shows: Capitulo Perfeito 2026, The Fortune Wild & Tipping Barrels, Glacier Project, The Cradle of Storms, Identidade
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
